{{Top|leg}}
'''Cape Regret''' was a small town in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]], far away from the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Bartyn's Landing]]. People from Cape Regret sometimes traveled to Bartyn's Landing, which was "the big [[City/Legends|city]]" for them.<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref>

Cape Regret had a port and also received traffic.<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref> C. [[69 BBY/Legends|69 BBY]], the fugitive [[Byrch Dyshkava]] escaped from the local [[Prison/Legends|jail]] in Bartyn's Landing and intended to go to either Cape Regret or [[Farsands]], another city of Lamaredd.<ref name="R" /> Later, c. [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], the procuress [[Miss Mylla]] wanted to send cargo, which in reality was a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] courtesan, to Cape Regret. This woman, who aimed to leave her current career with Mylla's blessing, was to meet one of Mylla's business contacts in Cape Regret.<ref name="BL" />

The dockmaster [[Howe Walwahd]], who lived in Bartyn's Landing, had a cousin operating a freelance trawler in Cape Regret.<ref name="R" />
